title: Isolation of Non-Parenchymal Liver Cells from Human Liver Biopsies
author: Charlotte Scott
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.viwe4fe
materials: Put liver biopsy in a new 50ml tube

Make antibody mix: 1. For Live CD45+ enrichment: Anti-Human CD45 APC-Cy7 Biolegend 368516 5ul/test (1 test = 5x10^6 cells in 100ul PBS) Fixable Live/Dead Viability Dye Stain Thermo Fischer 65-0866-18 1:300 in PBS. 2. For monocyte-macrophage enrichment: Anti-Human CD45 APC-Cy7 Biolegend 368516 5ul/test (1 test = 5x10^6 cells in 100ul PBS) Fixable Live/Dead Viability Dye Stain Thermo Fischer 65-0866-18 1:300 in PBS. Anti-Human CD14 AF488 Biolegend 301804 5ul/test Anti-Human CD16 PE-Dazzle 594 Biolegend 302054 5ul/test
Stain sample 5x10^6 cells in 100ul PBS + Antibodies for 00:30:00 at 4 °C

steps.title: Tissue Preparation
steps.instruction: Cut the human liver biopsy finely with scissors.

steps.title: Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue using RPMI containing enzymes in a shaking water bath.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL RPMI containing 1mg/ml Collagenase A and 10U/ml DNase
Incubate in a shaking water bath at 37 °C for 20 minutes
Shake vigorously by hand every 5 minutes

steps.title: Quenching and Filtration
steps.instruction: Stop the digestion and remove large debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL cold PBS and place on ice
Filter the suspension through a 100um filter

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells and remove the liquid.

steps.title: RBC Lysis (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform red blood cell lysis if required.

steps.title: Cell Resuspension and Counting
steps.instruction: Prepare cells in FACS buffer for counting.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in FACS buffer (2% FCS, 2mM EDTA, PBS)

steps.title: Fine Filtration and Staining Preparation
steps.instruction: Filter cells and prepare for flow cytometry staining.

substeps.instruction: Place cells on a plate or in a tube for staining
Resuspend at the desired concentration (2-5x10^6 in 200ul for flow cytometry staining)

steps.title: Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the stained cells using FACS buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 5ml FACS buffer to wash if staining in a tube, or 100ul FACS buffer to wash if staining in a plate
Proceed to FACS to sort cells as Live CD45+, and CD14+CD16-, CD14+CD16+ and CD14-CD16+
